news.description: Stocks and bonds fell as oil prices rebounded, with losses widening after the Treasury announced plans to buy up to $6 billion in longer-dated government paper. The reaction demonstrates that some investors had anticipated an even higher increase. Ten-year yields touched their highest level since 2023. Brent crude surpassed $101 as Middle East tensions fanned concerns about energy disruptions, adding to expectations that the Federal Reserve will boost interest rates to combat potential inflation
